owner_authorized: 2026-10-19, in chat: 'run merger arbitrage first, then the trend sleeve'
role: A DIVERSIFIER ALLOCATION judged forward, not an edge. Step 340: 80% SPY/GLD/SHY + 20% trend (AQR TSMOM factor less 1%) raised Sharpe 0.91 -> 1.00 and cut max drawdown -12.7% -> -7.8% over 2013-2026, bootstrap p 0.24, so it was closed as unproven alpha. A diversifier is better judged by its long external record and its crisis behaviour (2022: blend -7.4%, 80/20 -1.1%, trend +25.3%). This clock records what the allocation actually does from now on.

rule.why_these: Step 340's 80/20 split, not re-tuned. DBMF (iMGP DBi Managed Futures Strategy ETF) is the investable fund Step 340 already reported (since 2019-06: 80/20 Sharpe 1.21 vs 1.05, max DD -6.5% vs -12.7%); chosen because it has the longest record of the liquid managed-futures ETFs, not because it scored best.
rule.rebalance: reset to these weights every week, as static_spy_gld_shy_v1 is
rule.comparison_recorded_alongside: equal-thirds SPY/GLD/SHY computed from the SAME downloaded prices each week, so the comparison is like for like

leverage_disclosure: DBMF holds futures, long and short, with internal leverage. The investor borrows nothing and holds no short position; Step 340 left this to the owner and the owner asked for this sleeve. Recorded so the choice is visible.
prices: Yahoo adjusted closes (distributions included) downloaded at recording time for SPY, GLD, SHY, DBMF; the two closes used for each weekly return are stored in the observation record

cadence.window: at or after 21:00 UTC on the decision Friday and before 21:00 UTC the following Friday
cadence.missed_snapshot_policy: a missed window is left missed

reading_fixed_in_advance.confirms_if: after 52 weeks the 80/20's Sharpe is at least the base's AND its max drawdown is no deeper
reading_fixed_in_advance.refutes_if: the 80/20's Sharpe is more than 0.20 below the base's
reading_fixed_in_advance.longer_horizon: trend's value is concentrated in crises; one calm year can look bad without refuting it, so the clock continues past 52 weeks and every crisis window (an equity drawdown of more than 10%) is reported separately

mutation_policy: any change of weights, fund or rebalance creates v2 and restarts the clock
